source.text: ወ*ካልእት፡ ርኢኩ፡ በእንተ፡ መብረቅ፡ ከመ፡ ይቀውም፡ እምከዋክብት፡ ወይከውን፡ መብረቅ፡ ወኢይክል፡ ኀዲገ፡ ምስሎሙ።
source.note: Entire selected chapter is one unit, beginning at XLIV on printed84 and ending in the first body word on printed85 before XLV. Printed editorial star retained; apparatus call numbers excluded. Singular predicates and plural possessive suffix retained without harmonization.

translation.text: I saw something else concerning lightning:[a] how it rises from the stars and becomes lightning, and cannot leave their form.[b]

footnotes.text: The selected edition marks ካልእት with an editorial star. That marked form is retained; something else does not insert a new kind of lightning or a list of stars. The chapter contains a single unit, continued across the page break.

The selected predicates are singular: it rises, becomes, and cannot. The final printed ምስሎሙ has a plural possessive suffix, their form. Both are retained rather than changing the stars into an explicit plural subject or adding new before form. The relation is compressed in the selected text, and the English deliberately does not resolve it by rewriting.
